title: feat(app-shell): the marketplace catalog filters by the languages an app ships
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYH6pirAR8NaHkLvUrUr9cq)_

Fixes #31462
Part of #30284 (the console half; the cloud half is cloud#3803. PR #31855 landed the card line, the detail group and the null face; this PR lands the languages facet.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

No new `@object-ui/i18n` key: the facet row reuses `marketplace.facet.languages` from PR #31855, so no published type widens.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：应用市场目录在「职能/行业/类型」筛选旁新增「语言」一行，按钮来自云端返回的语言计数，例如「简体中文 3」。选中后按 `?languages=` 筛选，和其它筛选是 AND 关系。另外，卡片和详情页的默认语言改为按 `default_locale` 判定并排在最前，不再默认取第一个。
- **为什么改**：这是 #31462 剩下的筛选部分。云端已在卡片上说明计数位于 `data.facets.languages`。之前的实现把第一个语言当作默认语言，但云端说明默认语言不一定排在第一个。
- **风险与回滚**：改动只在控制台，不涉及接口和数据。云端没有返回语言计数时（生产环境目前就是这样），页面和现在一样。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`（`readLanguageCounts` 与 `languageFacetEntries`）、`MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx`（语言行）、`shippedLanguages.ts`（默认语言判定）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx`，预期 31 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，由席位落地。

## What changes

- **The served shape**, per the cloud lane's reading on the card (comment 6737348900, cloud `main` `d189d279`): the list answer is `{ items, total, limit, offset, facets }`, and `facets.languages` is an array of `{ value, count }`. It lists counts above zero only, most listings first, then by value. `value` is the stored locale tag, which `?languages=` takes back verbatim. The counts are disjunctive: a facet's counts apply every other filter but not its own selection.
- **`marketplaceApi.ts`**: `MarketplaceListResponse.facets` (`MarketplaceFacetCounts`, with all four count lists typed and only `languages` read) and `MarketplaceListParams.languages`, sent like the taxonomy facets as ONE comma-joined parameter.
- **`marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`**:
  - `FacetSelection.languages`.
  - `facetListParams` sends the selection sorted, so one selection is one request spelling.
  - `readLanguageCounts` reads `facets.languages`. It returns `null` when the answer has none, and drops an entry that is not a selectable value.
  - `languageFacetEntries` keeps the catalog's order, labels each value through #30514's reading (`localeLabel` over `resolveBuiltInLanguage`, via `languageLabel`), and appends any selected value the newest counts no longer name, without a count.
- **`MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx`**: a Languages row after the taxonomy rows, with toggle buttons carrying their count. With no counts and no selection, no row is drawn, so an empty list draws no facet, as an unserved taxonomy facet does.
- **`MarketplacePage.tsx`** keeps the newest answer's counts and hands them to the row.
- **`shippedLanguages.ts`, the default locale**: PR #31855 marked the first served locale as the default. The cloud lane's reading says the default is a row of `locale_coverage.locales` on every branch, but not always the first one, because the rows follow bundle order when the app declares no locales. The reader now marks the default by `locale_coverage.default_locale` and lists it first, on the card and on the package page. Without a coverage, nothing is marked.

## Tests

New cases in the existing harness files, each driven through the rendered page with the stubbed list door. The stub now also serves `facets` when a case gives it.

- `MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx`, "Marketplace languages facet":
  - The counts are drawn in the served order with native names and counts (`English4`, `简体中文3`, `日本語1`, `ไทย1`), and the first read sends no `languages`.
  - A selection sends `languages=zh-CN`, then `languages=ja-JP,zh-CN`. Deselecting both drops the parameter.
  - A selected `th` that another filter's answer no longer counts stays on the row, pressed, without a count.
  - CONTROL: an empty `languages` list, and an answer with no `facets`, both draw no row while the taxonomy rows still draw.
  - The card lists `简体中文 100% · English 80%` when `default_locale` is `zh-CN` and `zh-CN` is served second.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx`: the default is marked by `default_locale` and listed first, even when it is served last.

<details><summary>Runs at head 255fedcb (main c9246279, nothing newer on main at report time)</summary>

- `@object-ui/i18n` whole package, plus every file under `console/marketplace/__tests__/` and the three `LocaleSwitcher` tests: `Test Files 161 passed (161)`, `Tests 2409 passed | 13 skipped`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped (173)`, `Tests 5062 passed`.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 69/69 tasks, and the app-shell `type-check` executed (cache miss).
- `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each leg restored to its HEAD blob)</summary>

- `LIST_FILTERS` without `'languages'`: exactly the two cases that read the `?languages=` request go red (`2 failed | 29 passed`).
- `isDefault` keyed on `codes[0]` (the position, as before): exactly the two default-locale cases go red (`2 failed | 29 passed`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live verification NOT MEASURED.** Staging is unreachable from this container (the egress proxy answers 403 to CONNECT for the cloud hosts), so the shape is the cloud lane's quoted reading, and there are no live screenshots. Production does not serve the counts yet; there the catalog draws no languages row.
- **#31834** still stands. On the runtime's public-snapshot path (`OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`), the proxy filters the snapshot itself, ignores `?languages=`, and re-serializes the page without `facets`. On that path this row stays hidden, but a `?languages=` request sent there would answer the unfiltered catalog. The default path forwards the query to the cloud unchanged.
- The spec's `MarketplaceSearchResponseSchema.facets` declares no `languages`, and spells its counts camelCase, while the cloud door answers snake_case keys. This is noted only; no `packages/spec` change is in the claim.
